name: shake measure oral syringe
input: shake well before each use, measure 5 mL with oral syringe, take by mouth twice daily, rinse syringe after each use

name: shake and give liquid
input: shake bottle; give 2.5 ml po q8h x 7 days

name: mouth rinse swish spit
input: measure 10 mL, swish vigorously for 1 minute then spit out; do not swallow; do not eat or drink for 30 minutes

name: swish swallow QID
input: swish and swallow 5 mL four times daily after meals and at bedtime

name: gargle timed then spit
input: gargle 15 mL for 30 seconds then spit; no food for 30 min

name: dissolve packet in water
input: dissolve one packet in 4 ounces of water, stir, drink immediately

name: crush mix applesauce
input: crush tablet and mix with applesauce, swallow immediately, do not chew

name: swallow whole no manipulation
input: swallow whole; do not split crush chew or dissolve

name: empty stomach wait before food
input: take 1 tablet on empty stomach with water; wait 30 minutes before food, drink, or other meds

name: loading then maintenance dose
input: take 2 tabs now then 1 tab q12h for 4 doses

name: clean dry apply thin layer
input: clean affected area and dry thoroughly; apply thin layer twice daily morning and night

name: pea sized facial application
input: apply pea-sized amount to face nightly, avoid eyes and lips

name: part hair apply scalp wash hands
input: part hair, apply 1 mL to dry scalp twice daily, rub in gently, wash hands after

name: massage leave rinse scalp
input: massage into scalp, leave on 10 minutes then rinse

name: lather leave rinse hair
input: apply to wet hair, lather, leave 5 minutes, rinse thoroughly

name: external vulva no vaginal insertion
input: apply small amount to external vulva twice daily prn itching; do not insert into vagina

name: vaginal applicator course
input: insert one applicatorful vaginally at bedtime for 7 nights; wash applicator after each use

name: FTU taper
input: apply 1 fingertip unit to eczema patches twice daily for 5 days then once daily for 5 days

name: around not into wound
input: apply thin film around wound, not into wound, once daily

name: cover then change dressing
input: cover with dressing after applying; change dressing daily

name: inhaler rinse mouth
input: shake inhaler well, inhale 2 puffs morning and evening, rinse mouth with water and spit after use

name: prime inhaler local sprays
input: prime inhaler with 4 sprays before first use; re-prime with 2 sprays if unused >7 days

name: two puffs with breath hold
input: inhale 1 puff, hold breath 10 seconds, wait 30 seconds, inhale second puff

name: rinse mouth do not swallow
input: rinse mouth after inhalation; do not swallow rinse water

name: nasal spray aim away septum
input: spray 2 sprays in each nostril once daily, aim away from nasal septum

name: nasal spray priming
input: prime nasal spray until fine mist appears; re-prime if not used for 7 days

name: eye drop tip precaution
input: instill 1 drop into left eye qid; do not touch dropper tip to eye

name: pull eyelid instill close eyes
input: pull lower eyelid down, instill one drop into each eye, close eyes 2 minutes

name: punctal occlusion
input: instill 1 drop in affected eye; press inner corner for 1 minute

name: discard first then 1-2 drops
input: discard first drop, then instill 1-2 drops into each eye as needed

name: warm ear drops keep ear up
input: warm drops in hand, instill 5 drops into right ear twice daily, keep ear upward 5 minutes

name: ear drops pump tragus
input: insert 4 drops in ear, pump tragus 4 times

name: patch remove apply rotate
input: remove old patch, apply new patch to clean dry hairless skin twice weekly; rotate sites

name: patch falls off conditional
input: if patch falls off, reapply; if it will not stick, apply a new patch to another site

name: fold discard patch
input: fold used patch sticky sides together and discard; do not flush

name: insulin rotate sites
input: inject 10 units subcutaneously once daily at same time; rotate injection sites

name: inject after wipe pinch
input: wipe skin with alcohol and let dry, pinch skin, inject 0.25 mg subcutaneously, keep needle in 6 seconds

name: avoid damaged injection skin
input: do not inject into bruised tender scarred or lumpy skin

name: mealtime insulin
input: inject 5 units 15 minutes before meal or immediately after meal

name: draw up mixed insulin
input: draw up rapid acting insulin first, then NPH, inject immediately

name: rectal suppository PRN
input: use 1 suppository rectally at bedtime as needed for constipation

name: vaginal suppository course
input: insert 1 suppository vaginally nightly for 3 nights

name: rectal applicator squeeze
input: insert applicator into rectum and squeeze contents, keep lying on left side 30 minutes

name: ophthalmic ointment ribbon
input: apply 1 inch ribbon of ointment inside lower eyelid at bedtime

name: Thai shake measure oral liquid
input: เขย่าขวดก่อนใช้ ตวงยา 5 มล. ด้วยไซริงค์ รับประทานวันละ 3 ครั้ง หลังอาหาร

name: Thai mouth rinse spit
input: กลั้วปาก 10 มล. 1 นาที แล้วบ้วนทิ้ง ห้ามกลืน และงดอาหารน้ำ 30 นาที

name: Thai clean dry topical
input: ทำความสะอาดผิวให้แห้ง ทาบางๆ บริเวณรอยโรค เช้าเย็น หลีกเลี่ยงรอบดวงตา

name: Thai medicated shampoo
input: สระผมด้วยยา ทิ้งไว้ 5 นาที แล้วล้างออกให้สะอาด ใช้สัปดาห์ละ 2 ครั้ง

name: Thai inhaler rinse mouth
input: พ่นยาเข้าปาก 2 ครั้ง เช้าเย็น หลังพ่นให้บ้วนปากด้วยน้ำแล้วบ้วนทิ้ง

name: Thai SC injection rotate avoid
input: ฉีดใต้ผิวหนังที่หน้าท้องหรือต้นขา สลับตำแหน่งทุกครั้ง ห้ามฉีดบริเวณช้ำหรือแข็ง
